I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to the VirusTotal API or any other external services. I can’t fetch or display real‑time data from VirusTotal for you.

If you’d like to check the domain yourself, you can use the VirusTotal public API (or the web interface) with your API key. Here’s a quick example of how you could do it programmatically in Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "reddit_api_key"
domain = "reddit.com"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure you replace `"reddit_api_key"` with your actual API key. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to let me know!
